profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Coursera | Backend Systems, Generative AI & Developer Productivity
profile.summary:
I'm a software engineer passionate about solving complex problems, building elegant systems, and pushing the boundaries of what's possible with emerging technology.

At Coursera, I work on backend infrastructure, AI-powered learning experiences, and large-scale localization. I've pioneered AI-assisted development workflows, modernized production systems, and driven major reductions in AI inference costs.

I'm especially interested in AI-native software engineering, rethinking how we design, build, and maintain software rather than simply writing code faster.

Outside of Coursera, I founded Abacus Press, where I built an AI-driven publishing pipeline that enabled the production of approximately 80 books in a year.

I value curiosity, clear communication, thoughtful design, and turning ambitious ideas into real-world impact.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed backend infrastructure and AI-powered learning experiences at Coursera.  
• Modernized production services from Scala/Naptime to Java, GraphQL, and gRPC.  
• Led technical design for multilingual text-to-speech and localization systems.  
• Championed AI-native engineering practices, recognized for innovation at internal Demo Day.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Artificial Intelligence (AI) · Distributed Systems · Software Architecture · Prompt Engineering · Scala · GraphQL · gRPC · Test-Driven Development · Agentic Workflows · Large Language Models (LLM) · Microservices · TypeScript · React.js · REST APIs · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · Developer Productivity

positions.title: Founder/Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Created the world's first LEGO Virtual Reality software in Unity C# that works with 5000+ official bricks.
•	Optimized framerate to 72 FPS by using custom batching and multithreaded real time CAD loading.
•	Marketed demos on social media, amassing 30,000 followers in 30 days, and 4 million+ views: www.tiktok.com/@brickmastervr

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Designed a Python REST API to allow users to upload, render, and normalize CAD models.
•	Optimized synthetic data simulator in Unity, increasing performance from 30 to 60 FPS.
•	Developed Docker application in Python and Blender which renders and normalizes CAD models uploaded by user to AWS S3.
•	Utilized project management and testing software such as Jira, Jenkins, git, and Confluence.

positions.title: 3D Reconstruction Engineer
positions.description:
•	Collected drone data of historic buildings to be used for photogrammetry.
•	3D modelled CAD models using drone data to represent houses in Blender.
•	Engineered augmented reality smartphone-controlled 3D globe which represented the Earth and various planets in different atmospheric conditions.

positions.title: Data Analytics Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
•	Led study sessions once a week to teach students Data Science fundamental concepts including Python, Flask, git, AWS, scikit learn, deep learning, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, JavaScript, and Pandas.
•	Assisted professor during class by overseeing group work and helping answer students’ questions.

positions.title: Database Administrator Internship
positions.description:
•	Designed SQL relational database schema and interface in Python to house data for a cancer research nodule radiology machine learning research project.
•	Collaborated with lab technicians to design a PostgreSQL relational database.
